purpose: One candidate trained on all sixteen currently eligible development photos with immutable original foreground. It must subsequently beat the production pipeline on the separately frozen source-held-out board sample before any integration.

protocol.architecture: Shared original blocks 0–8, immutable original body tail/decoder, trainable separate material blocks 9–11 and decoder; all BatchNorm statistics fixed.
protocol.checkpointSelection: Fixed final update; no evaluation image, metric, threshold tuning or early stopping.
protocol.objective: Existing image-wide phase-exchangeable material supervision; the foreground loss is constant with respect to trainable parameters.

releaseGate: Independent replay proves source separation, unchanged frozen tensors and body output, and saved model predictions.
Export and actual browser inference must be audited on the new single model, not inferred from the older two-fold models.
Complete paired photo-to-editable-template replay with independent geometry, paper, mask and visual checks on the predeclared evaluation sample.
No deterioration of supported production cases under the fallback policy; any new supported crop must be checked against the photograph.
